```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parsed entity value'> ">
  %pe;
  <?target-pi data-attr="test"?>
  <!-- DTD internal subset comment -->
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Root level comment -->
  <?root-pi processing instruction value?>
  <ns2:child>
    &ent;
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with markup-like characters: <tag> & "quotes"
    ]]>
  </ns2:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "http://example.org/">
  <!ENTITY ref "&base;entity">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
  <!-- Nested DTD comment structure -->
]>
<catalog xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns="http://example.org/ns">
  <?catalog-pi action="init"?>
  <!-- Item comment -->
  <item xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="&ref;">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw data containing <script>alert(1)</script> and &ref;
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext SYSTEM "http://localhost/external.ent">
  %ext;
  <?xml-meta version="1.0"?>
  <!-- Comment inside DOCTYPE -->
]>
<doc xmlns="urn:doc" xmlns:sub="urn:sub">
  <!-- Section comment -->
  <?sub:pi attr="value"?>
  <sub:section>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA content with entity reference simulation & and tags <foo/>
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </sub:section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (content)*>
  <!ELEMENT content (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY beta "α Beta">
  <!ENTITY gamma "β Gamma">
  <?pi-test processing-instruction?>
  <!-- Comment before DTD close -->
]>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/document" xmlns:ext="http://xml.org/ext">
  <!-- Pre-content comment -->
  <?ext-pi mode="debug"?>
  <ext:content>
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed character data block <node attr="value"> γ
    ]]>
    γ
  </ext:content>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE notes [
  <!ELEMENT notes (note+)>
  <!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY note-ent "Important Note">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <?xml-stylesheet href="notes.css" type="text/css"?>
  <!-- DTD internal comment block -->
]>
<notes xmlns="http://example.org/notes" xmlns:author="http://example.org/author">
  <!-- Document body comment -->
  <?author:pi name="John Doe"?>
  <author:note>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing complex symbols: <>&'"--]]>>
    ]]>
    &note-ent;
  </author:note>
</notes>
```
